vacancy.title: Antenna Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESTEC RF Payloads and Technology Division role covering antenna, payload and instrument design, testing and performance analysis; specialised RF/communications background is a substantial mismatch for mechanical engineering. Official Starion vacancy overview now shows deadline 26 October 2026, while the individual vacancy detail page still shows 19 October 2026; verify with recruiter before relying on the later date.
